Red Clip is a soft clipper modelled on Lavry Gold style conversion, for iPad and iPhone. Use it on its own with your audio files, or as an AUv3 plug-in inside Logic Pro and other hosts. It has Hard, Classic and Modern clip knees, Red saturation (Modern up to +2.5 dB, Classic up to +6 dB) with Unity gain, Fire, Box Tone, Delta, oversampling, a live scope of the audio before and after the clipper, LED meters, LUFS readouts, A/B compare, and over 100 presets. You can switch between the red and Platinum faceplates in Settings.
